issues: The preview-only 'Made with Emergent' fixed badge at bottom-right (z-index 9999) overlaps the bottom-tab-import accent FAB at <400px widths. This is Emergent preview infrastructure chrome, NOT part of the product (not present in production builds), so no action needed — flagged only for future testing agents so they hide the badge via JS before clicking the Import tab at mobile widths.

action_items: None — PWA conversion is complete and all 9 review-request items verified passing.
critical_code_review_comments: service-worker.js registration is correctly gated behind window.self===window.top (index.html L197) so it does not register inside the Emergent preview iframe — intentional and expected.
BottomNav.js L13 early-returns when path does not start with /arthvyay — correctly keeps the bar off public marketing pages and off the /arthverse/portal launcher. Good scoping.

InstallPrompt.js L20 uses window.navigator.standalone (non-standard iOS property) in addition to matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') — correct iOS detection. Dismissal persists via localStorage 'pwa_install_dismissed' — good UX.

manifest.json icons purpose field: the 192x192 and 512x512 have 'any maskable' which is fine, but all three entries point at the same /arth-verse-logo.png — the 180x180 is served at 192/512/180 by the same source. For best maskable rendering, provide distinct square-cropped icons with safe padding. Non-blocking, but Lighthouse PWA audit will flag it.

service-worker.js caches GET requests for image/style/script/font but does NOT version the assets cache beyond CACHE_VERSION='arthverse-v1' — a new deploy that updates scripts will only purge old caches when CACHE_VERSION bumps. Since CRA outputs hashed filenames, stale assets will naturally expire, but confirm the bump convention is used in future iterations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all mobile bottom-nav + desktop top-nav + tab navigation + dashboard cards validated live)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Authoritative regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_24_pwa_regression.py (pytest, 8 tests, hits public URL). Frontend testing gotchas: (1) Login at /arthverse/auth?mode=login lands on /arthverse/portal (app launcher), NOT /arthvyay/dashboard — navigate explicitly to /arthvyay/dashboard after login. (2) A 60-second onboarding modal may appear on first dashboard visit — dismiss via button[aria-label='Close']. (3) The Emergent preview 'Made with Emergent' badge (id='emergent-badge', z-index 9999, bottom-right) overlaps the center Import FAB at mobile widths — hide it in tests with: document.getElementById('emergent-badge').style.display='none'. (4) Service worker will NOT register inside preview iframe (window.self!==window.top gate) — this is intentional. Don't try to validate sw is active. (5) InstallPrompt will NOT show a UI in Playwright because beforeinstallprompt doesn't fire — only verify the component mounts without errors.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All PWA deliverables (manifest, service-worker, Apple meta tags, viewport-fit, service worker registration, BottomNav mobile-only visibility at <768px with 4 correctly-routed tabs, top nav desktop-only visibility at >=768px, InstallPrompt mounting safely) work exactly as specified in the review request. Backend APIs completely unaffected by the PWA changes.
